slides.label: Open models · Oct 6, 2026
slides.title: A 740M model beat a 1 trillion one on my list
slides.body: Here's why the small launch matters more for agents

slides.label: The setup
slides.title: Two launches. Same day.
slides.body: Mistral shipped a 1T-parameter giant. Google shipped a 740M embedding model. Guess which one got the headlines.

slides.label: The giant
slides.title: Mistral Large 4
slides.body: 49B active params. Preview API at $1.36 in, $4.18 out per 1M tokens. Weights land end of October.

slides.label: The small one
slides.title: EmbeddingGemma 2
slides.body: Text, code, images, audio and video in one embedding space. Apache 2.0, on Hugging Face now. 191MB RAM on a phone.

slides.label: The twist
slides.title: MTEB Code, up from 68.76
slides.body: And truncate vectors from 768 to 128 dims for up to 6x less storage.

slides.label: My take
slides.title: Fix retrieval before you upgrade the LLM
slides.body: A lot of bad agent answers start at retrieval. A new embedder is a swap you can test today. A 1T model is a hosting decision you can't make until the weights ship.
